summary: The 8-K reports the issuance and sale of commercial mortgage pass-through certificates by D2-Natixis Multifamily Mortgage Trust 2026-M1, a newly formed ABS issuing entity, with Natixis Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC as depositor. The public offering of $377.96 million in certificates was made through underwriters; private certificates were also sold. Proceeds funded the purchase of 20 multifamily mortgage loans. This is a routine securitization transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or similar corporate event is involved, so the filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
